text:
sam: heads-up: launching a VPC/IAM boundary change in eu-west-1 just rolled back some nodes — seeing a bunch of GPU nodes stuck NotReady and boot loops. suspect IAM boundary blocked the audit-shipper role.

marta: ugh. can you paste the failures? any KMS denies in the logs? :eyes:

sam: logs from node-init: 
```
Sep 21 09:12:01 node-init[456]: audit-shipper sidecar failed to start: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/gpu-node-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/alias/central-audit-key
```

devon: that explains it — sidecar can't decrypt streaming keys, so it keeps retrying and hitting backoff which delays kubelet readiness. result: lifecycle controller draining and requeueing the node boot, warm pool churn.

alisha: any firewall/eproxy changes too? we also got elevated S3 403s from the shipper earlier.

sam: yes, yesterday infra tightened egress to S3 endpoints for the edge subnets (NACL + SG). some nodes use private S3 endpoint, others go via NAT; mixed traffic pattern causing intermittent 403/timeouts. combined with KMS denies -> heavy retry.

ryan: cost note: warm-pool churn + repeated upload retries spiked egress and Lambda retries — approx 18k extra requests last hour, rough ~$120 extra in S3 + request costs. not huge but affects onboarding SLA.

marta: immediate mitigation: can we add a temporary IAM exception to the role boundary to allow kms:Decrypt for the audit key alias and open the S3 endpoint SG for the affected subnets?

sam: I'm testing a minimal policy now. if we revert the role-boundary change it's broader than I want. propose adding this inline policy to the gpu-node-role for a quick canary: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/central-audit-key",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

devon: that should get sidecar decrypts back. also need to add S3 endpoint SG rule: allow outbound 443 to vpce-0abc... for the subnet. alisha can you patch the NACL?

alisha: on it. will add a temporary NACL allow for ephemeral ports -> 443 for the two affected subnets and mark with ticket INF-4923.

ryan: after we stabilize, we should replace the overly-broad inline exception with a scoped IAM role assumption via sts:AssumeRole to a dedicated audit-shipper-role that has only decrypt + s3:PutObject to the logging bucket. lowers blast radius.

marta: agree. long-term fix: update the role-boundary tooling to automatically include explicit exceptions for central infra agents (audit, metrics, keystore) during rollouts. current rollout removed them silently.

sam: root-cause hypothesis: a new policy template for org/role-boundaries (PR #4821) accidentally dropped the allow-list entry for alias/central-audit-key in eu-west-1. rollout used fast path and auto-applied to all gpu-node roles.

devon: ops-bot: can you post the recent role-boundary deploy and diff? @ops-bot

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] role-boundary v2.9.1 deployed 2026-03-21T08:55:17Z by @ci-system. Diff summary: removed 1 allow-list entry referencing kms alias arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/central-audit-key. Full diff: https://ci.internal/reports/4821/diff

alisha: thanks. rolling the temporary exceptions now. I'll ping when NACL + SG done.

sam: after policy patch, I see sidecars starting on two test nodes. login: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/audit-shipper -f | tail -n 40
```

marta: nice. once we confirm 10 nodes stable, schedule a controlled rollback of that PR and re-run the role-boundary deploy with the allow-list restored and an automated test.

ryan: also add monitoring: alert when node-init spends >3m in NotReady during onboarding and when audit-shipper experiences >5% upload error rate for 10min. ticketing INF-4924.

devon: follow-up action items: 
- alisha: patch NACL/SG (temp) + ticket INF-4923 (ETA 20m)
- sam: deploy inline decrypt exception to gpu-node-role canary (done)
- marta: revert PR #4821 and reapply with tests (ETA 2h)
- ryan: add alerts and cost tracking (ETA 4h)

alisha: NACL + SG patched, canary nodes now healthy. monitoring shows reduced retries.

sam: rolling policy change to remaining zones paused until PR fix.

marta: thanks team. postmortem draft please — include cost delta, rollout gap, and a plan to add a preflight check for required infra roles.

ryan: I'll start the postmortem skeleton and add the raw S3/KMS metrics.

sam: closing here, will follow up in INF-4924. :thumbsup:
